evidence.observation: Growth T holding at 749.9 °C against a 750 °C setpoint. It overshot by 10.5 °C at 2520 s, then settled.
Pressure steady at about 760.7 Torr, with no sign of a leak or blockage.
Ar flow at 99.8 sccm, matching the 100 sccm setpoint.
Sensor not installed. Growth stage requires it, so O2 in the atmosphere can't be verified.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or another independent check of the atmosphere such as a leak check or a portable O2 measurement, to confirm the growth atmosphere is oxygen-free. The sample also hasn't been characterized yet.
